## Academic Positions & Qualifications

- **Associate Professor in Statistics** (SECS-S/01)  
  *Department of Social Sciences, University of Foggia* (Dec 2024 – present)
- **Italian National Scientific Qualification (ASN) as Full Professor**  
  *Sector 13/D3 – Social Statistics and Demography* (Valid 2024 – 2034)
- **Tenure Track Assistant Professor (RTD-B) in Statistics**  
  *Department of Social Sciences, University of Foggia* (Dec 2021 – Dec 2024)
- **Postdoctoral Research Fellow**  
  *Department of Social and Political Sciences, Bocconi University* (2020 – 2021)
- **Research Fellow**  
  *Department of Statistics, Sapienza University of Rome* (2019 – 2020)
- **Epidemiologic Surveillance Research Fellow**  
  *Local Health Department of Padua ULSS6* (2016)

## Education

- **Ph.D. in Methodological Statistics** (Demographic and Social Curriculum)  
  *Sapienza University of Rome*, Department of Statistical Sciences (2016 – 2020)
- **European Doctoral School of Demography (EDSD)**  
  *Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research (MPIDR)* & *University of Southern Denmark (SDU)* (2017 – 2018)  
  *Intensive pan-European mathematical and statistical demography training program.*
- **M.Sc. in Statistical and Actuarial Sciences**  
  *Sapienza University of Rome* (Summa cum Laude)
- **B.Sc. in Statistics and Information Management**  
  *Sapienza University of Rome*

## Visiting Stays & International Fellowships

- **Macquarie University (Australia):** Honorary Visiting Fellow, Business School, Department of Actuarial Studies and Business Analytics
- **Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research (MPIDR, Germany):** Visiting Scholar
- **University of Southern Denmark (SDU):** Visiting Scholar, Interdisciplinary Centre on Population Dynamics (CPop)
- **Aarhus University (Denmark):** Visiting Scholar, Department of Clinical Epidemiology
- **York University (Canada):** Collaborative Grantee with the *Individual Finance & Insurance Decisions (IFID) Centre*

## Selected Grants & Recognitions

- **Research Grant recipient**, *Individual Finance & Insurance Decisions (IFID) Centre* (with Prof. Moshe A. Milevsky, York University)
- **Principal Investigator / Co-Investigator** on national and European demographic and longevity modeling initiatives
